name: Baked Greek Shrimp Saganaki with Feta and Rice

components.name: Shrimp Saganaki

ingredients.name: Salt, moderate because olives and feta salty

steps: Preheat oven to 200 C. Toss tomatoes, shallot, olives, garlic and oil in a shallow roasting dish and bake about 15 minutes until tomatoes start collapsing.
Stir in lemon juice and seasonings, then fold raw shrimp gently into the hot vegetables in a single layer.
Scatter feta cubes across the top and bake another 8-12 minutes, until shrimp reach 63 C and feta softens.
Pack the tomato-feta shrimp separately from measured rice. Finish with dill after reheating.

components.name: Basmati Rice
steps: While tray bakes, rinse dry rice and cook in measured water; rest covered before fluffing.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; macros and cooked yields are estimates.
Skinnytaste source is a skillet shrimp saganaki. This is an OVEN adaptation with a calculated rice side.
Freezer: cooked shrimp and feta do not retain ideal texture when frozen

Refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers at 4°C or colder, for 3–4 days at most, and follow the shorter seafood limit above. Cook fish and shellfish to 63°C and reheat leftovers to at least 74°C.
